notes.text: WORKFLOW: sampling rate and aliasing. The same 24 h rhythm, recorded at 30-minute epochs and then re-sampled once every 13 hours. The fine record recovers 24 h cleanly. The slow one cannot: to resolve a period you need samples at intervals shorter than HALF that period (the Nyquist limit), and 13 h intervals can only resolve periods longer than 26 h. So the rhythm is not merely noisy in the slow record, it is unrecoverable, and the periodogram peaks somewhere else entirely with no warning that anything is wrong. Before concluding a rhythm is absent, check your epoch length against the period you were hoping to find.
